Proposal

Epson fiscal cash registers built into GenroApp

proposal/fiscal-epson2026-11-20Giovanni Porcariaccepted

Problem

A GenroPy page must print fiscal receipts and run the daily closure on a cash register of the shop. The page cannot reach the register by itself:

  • the page is served over HTTPS and the register answers on the local network, often over plain HTTP: the browser blocks the mixed request;
  • the register is on a private address of the shop, which the GenroPy server cannot reach.

GenroApp runs on the computer of the shop, on the same network as the register. It can send the request in Rust and give the answer to the page. The first registers are the Epson FP-81 II RT and FP-90 III RT. RCH Print!F and Custom may follow.

Current state

  • Cash registers are built into GenroApp in Rust, by the decision d-builtin.
  • No code in GenroApp talks to a cash register today.

Proposed solution

Protocol

The protocol is Epson "ePOS Fiscal Print". The sources are three Epson documents published on scontrinosmart.it, all marked confidential by Epson:

  • "ePOS Fiscal Print Solution Development Guide", FP 000 055 EN Rev. U, 2023-12-01 (below: Guide). Rev. T on download4.epson.biz answers HTTP 403; Rev. U replaces it.
  • "Fiscal Printer Intelligent Features Guide", FP 000 056 EN Rev. L, 2023-12-29, for both FP-81 II RT and FP-90 III RT (below: Features).
  • "Communication Protocol", FP 000 008 EN Rev 8.10, 2023-12-18 (below: Protocol).

Secondary sources, used only to confirm: Epson fiscalprint.js 1.1.0, Odoo 19 l10n_it_pos, OCA fiscal_epos_print.

readGuide §2.2.1-2.2.32026-11-20
A request is POST /cgi-bin/fpmate.cgi?devid=local_printer&timeout=10000 with Content-Type: text/xml; charset=utf-8. The body is a SOAP envelope s:Envelope / s:Body (namespace http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/) holding one root: printerFiscalReceipt, printerFiscalReport or printerCommand.
readFeatures §82026-11-20
HTTP or HTTPS is a setting of the register (SET 34, SSL MODE 0, 1 or 2), not of the model. With SSL on, only HTTPS on port 443 answers, with a self-signed or uploaded certificate.
readGuide §7, Features §22026-11-20
A user and password are optional on the register. On a standalone RT model they use HTTP Digest authentication.
readGuide §3.11, §6.1-6.22026-11-20
The answer is <response success="true|false" code="…" status="…"> with an addInfo child. code names the error (PRINTER ERROR, EPTR_REC_EMPTY, PARSER_ERROR, …); with PRINTER ERROR, status is the native error number of the Protocol §8.3.1.
readGuide §5.4.1, §5.8.1, §5.9.162026-11-20
After a receipt addInfo carries fiscalReceiptNumber, fiscalReceiptAmount, fiscalReceiptDate, fiscalReceiptTime, zRepNumber, serialNumber. After a report it carries zRepNumber, dailyAmount, serialNumber. After queryPrinterStatus statusType="1" it carries the rt… fields.
readGuide §2.2.2, §5.22026-11-20
Amounts and quantities in a request accept dot or comma, with no thousands separator. Amounts in an answer use a comma unless the URL carries reply_decimal_separator=..
readGuide §3.132026-11-20
fpmate resets the register at every fiscal request: a receipt left open is cancelled.
readGuide §5.4.142026-11-20
paymentType is 0 cash, 1 cheque, 2 credit or electronic, 3 ticket, 4 multiple tickets, 5 not paid, 6 payment discount. index selects the totaliser inside the type.
readGuide §6, Protocol §12026-11-20
The fpmate XML has no element specific to FP-81 II RT or FP-90 III RT. The differences are in native commands reached through directIO, which this proposal does not use.

Not verified, and left out of the first version:

  • the details of the Digest authentication (realm, algorithm, qop);
  • whether the register refuses a request without SOAPAction or If-Modified-Since: GenroApp sends both, as the Guide and fiscalprint.js do;
  • the meaning of payment="0" on cash in the examples of the Guide: GenroApp always sends the amount;
  • the format of rtExpiryCD and rtExpiryCA (the Guide says yyyymmdd, the Protocol says DDMMYY): GenroApp passes them as text;
  • the name of each electronic totaliser index 1-10: it is a programming of each register.

Commands for the page

Four commands, granted at runtime only to the windows of saved sites, for the origin of the site, like device_login::grant. Each command checks that origin is the origin of the calling page and of a saved site, like device_login::caller_site. The page never passes an address.

CommandXML sentResult
fiscal_status({origin})queryPrinterStatus with statusType="0", then "1"{configured, printer_status, cpu_rel, mf_status, rt: {main_status, sub_status, daily_open, no_working_period, files_to_send, …}}
fiscal_receipt({origin, lines, payments})printerFiscalReceipt: beginFiscalReceipt, one printRecItem per line, one printRecTotal per payment, endFiscalReceipt{number, amount, date, time, z_number, serial}
fiscal_x_report({origin})printerFiscalReport / printXReport{z_number, daily_amount, serial}
fiscal_daily_closure({origin})printerFiscalReport / printZReport{z_number, daily_amount, serial}
Arguments of fiscal_receipt
  • type is one of cash, cheque, electronic, ticket, not_paid, mapped to paymentType 0, 1, 2, 3, 5. index is optional; the register uses 1 when it is missing.
  • Amounts and quantities are decimal strings with a dot, at most 2 and 3 decimals, as the Guide §5.2 accepts them. A float from JavaScript is refused: it cannot carry cents exactly.
  • A description longer than 38 characters, or with a character the Guide §8 lists as not printable, is refused with an error. GenroApp does not truncate or replace text on its own.
  • An answer with success="false" becomes an error with code, status and, for a native error, its Italian name from the Protocol §8.3.1.
must
GenroApp sends one request at a time to each register. A second command waits for the first one.
fpmate resets the register at every request (Guide §3.13): a second request would cancel a receipt in progress
must
The HTTP timeout of GenroApp is longer than the timeout of the request: 10 s for status and receipts, 60 s for the closure.
the Z report waits for the transmission to the tax authority before it answers (Guide §3.4)

Configuration in Gestione

The window Gestione gains a section "Registratore di cassa" for each saved site:

  • address of the register (host or IP, optional port);
  • a box "HTTPS", for a register with SSL MODE 1 or 2;
  • a button "Prova", which runs queryPrinterStatus and shows serial number, firmware and RT state.
The HTTPS client is rustls: it speaks TLS 1.2 and 1.3 only. A register with SSL MODE 1 that offers only an older version does not connect.

The configuration is saved in <app config dir>/fiscal.json, keyed by the origin of the site. The commands of this section are granted only to the window manage (capabilities/manage.json).

Code

  • src-tauri/src/fiscal.rs: the four page commands, the grant, the configuration, the lock per register, the pinned certificate, and the three commands manage_fiscal_get, manage_fiscal_set, manage_fiscal_test of Gestione.
  • src-tauri/src/fiscal/epson.rs: building the XML and reading the answer. No I/O, so the tests run without a register.
  • setup/manage.html, setup/manage.js: the section of Gestione. manage.rs: removing a site also removes its register.
  • lib.rs (handler list), build.rs (command list), documents.rs (call to the grant), capabilities/manage.json, Cargo.toml (XML crate).

RCH and Custom get their own file beside epson.rs when they are written. A shared trait waits for the second register.

Tests

  • The XML built for status, receipt, X report and Z report is compared with the expected text.
  • The answers are parsed from samples shaped like those of the Guide §5.4.1, §5.8.1, §5.9.16, §6.5 and §6.10: success, PRINTER ERROR, offline, comma amounts.
  • Validation: description too long, unsupported character, float amount, more than 2 decimals, unknown payment type.
No test runs against a real register. A test on an FP-81 II RT or FP-90 III RT is needed before release, and it settles the points listed as not verified.

Decisions

decidedd-fiscal-scope
What does the first version cover?
  1. Status, receipt, X report, daily closure

    Sales and payments only. No discounts, refunds, voids, lottery code, customer tax code.

  2. Also refund and void

    Adds printRecRefund and the REFUND / VOID messages of the Guide §5.5. They need the number, date and serial of the original receipt.

Choice: Status, receipt, X report, daily closure (GP, 2026-11-20)
Status, receipt, X report and daily closure. Refund and void come later.
decidedd-fiscal-key
Is the register bound to a site or to the computer?
  1. One register per saved site

    fiscal.json keyed by origin. Two sites on the same computer each name their register, also the same one.

  2. One register per computer

    Every saved site uses it. Simpler to configure; a site that should not print can still print.

Choice: One register per saved site (GP, 2026-11-20)
One register per saved site, in fiscal.json keyed by origin.
decidedd-fiscal-tls
How does GenroApp trust the self-signed certificate of a register with HTTPS?
  1. Pin the certificate at the test

    "Prova" shows the SHA-256 fingerprint; the user confirms it and GenroApp saves it in fiscal.json. Later connections accept only that certificate. Needs a custom rustls verifier.

  2. Accept any certificate

    Encryption without identity: another machine on the network can answer in place of the register.

Choice: Pin the certificate at the test (GP, 2026-11-20)
The certificate is pinned at the test in Gestione.
decidedd-fiscal-auth
What about a register with user and password (HTTP Digest)?
  1. Not in the first version

    An answer 401 becomes the error "Il registratore chiede una password: non ancora supportato". Digest is added after a test on a real register.

  2. Implement Digest now

    Written without a verified realm and algorithm, and without a register to test it.

Choice: Not in the first version (GP, 2026-11-20)
No Digest authentication in the first version.
decidedd-fiscal-confirm
Does GenroApp ask the user before the daily closure?
  1. Native dialog before the Z report

    The closure cannot be undone. A dialog of GenroApp, not of the page, names the site and the register.

  2. The page decides

    The page already asks; GenroApp runs the command.

Choice: Native dialog before the Z report (GP, 2026-11-20)
A native dialog of GenroApp before the Z report.
decidedd-fiscal-build
Is the code always in the build, or behind a cargo feature?
  1. Always built

    No new dependency except an XML crate. It works in the distributed build, as d-builtin requires.

  2. Feature fiscal

    Fits the split of features under way in another branch. One more combination to build.

Choice: Always built (GP, 2026-11-20)
Always built, no cargo feature.

Consequences

  • Cargo.toml gains an XML crate (quick-xml) for reading the answer. The request is built by hand with escaping, so its text is fixed in the tests.
  • The files shared with the branches on local printing and on downloaded modules (Cargo.toml, lib.rs, build.rs, manage.rs, setup/manage.*) need an agreed order of merge.
  • A saved site can print fiscal receipts on the register configured for it, with no further confirmation except the closure if d-fiscal-confirm says so.
  • The register must be reachable from the computer: same network, port 80 or 443 open.
